title: Ukulala Ngaphandle Kwexesha
intro: Khawucinge ngexesha apho inyaniso yayithuliswa kwaye amakholwa ezingelwa. Iqela elincinci lakhetha ukuphumla endaweni yokuzinikela, lifumana indawo yokukhosela kwiindawo ezingalindelekanga - indawo eyayiza kuba yindawo yabo yokuphumla kangangeenkulungwane ezingenakubalwa. Ekugqibeleni bakuba bevukile, ihlabathi lalitshintshile libajikelezile. Ngoobani aba bantu baleleyo?
clues: Uluntu lwethu lwafuna ukuba sinqule kunye nabo, kodwa sala.
Sabaleka kwisixeko sifuna indawo yokusabela kwabo babechasa iinkolelo zethu.
Iqabane elithembekileyo elinemilenze emine lahlala emnyango wendawo yethu yokuzimela.
U-Allah wasenza salala iminyaka engamakhulu amathathu anesithoba.
Ekugqibeleni xa savukayo, isixeko sethu esasikade sitshutshiswa samkela ukholo.

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
